messages:
rachel_support: P1 esk -> CedarSpring trial onboarding failing. Provision API returning 403 on new keys, automation retries also failing. Renewal ~3w. Ticket SUP-140321 opened. Looping CS for handoff and comms plan.

deploy-bot: Alert: 6 provisioning failures for tenant cedarspring-trial in 6h. Error: 403 auth_invalid. https://redwood.inc/alerts/SUP-140321

erin_cs: Thanks Rachel. I'll own comms. Mason/Varun can you confirm if this is a platform regression or tenant misconfig? Need impacted endpoints list and rough ETA for mitigation.

rachel_support: Repro (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inc/v1/tenants/cedarspring-trial/embeds" -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_***' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
# response: {"status":403,"error":"auth_invalid"}
```
SE tried manual rotate; customer reports rotated key also 403.

varun_eng: We merged a change to short-lived token handling yesterday. Rolling verifier back to verify. If rollback helps, we'll push a hotfix.

mason_se: I can run a cache invalidate and prepare a secure upload link for an ephemeral token. Erin, can you ask the customer for a 20-min window tomorrow 2:00pm ET and to pause auto-rotate during repro?

emma_ae: I'll join the call. Renewal risk: medium-high. Please include a non-technical note we can send to the customer.

erin_cs: Draft customer note:
"Hi CedarSpring — we're investigating intermittent provisioning failures affecting API key validation. We're scheduling a troubleshooting session for tomorrow at 2:00pm ET and recommend pausing automatic key rotation until we complete testing. As a temporary step please try a manual key rotate and confirm; our team will run a live test. We'll follow up within 24 hours with remediation details. For urgent help, contact ops@redwood.com"

rachel_support: Add SUP-140321 and impacted endpoints: POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/embeds, POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/provision. Marked P1.

varun_eng: Rolling back verifier now, ETA 15m to confirm. If rollback clears failures we'll publish RCA + timeline.

mason_se: Secure upload link ready; will send after Erin confirms the window.

erin_cs: Owners: Rachel = support owner, Mason = SE lead, Varun = eng owner, Emma = AE/renewal follow-up. I'll update SUP-140321 with the comms draft and calendar invite.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-20260323-14. Runbook: onboarding-provisioning. Escalation level: CS-P1.

\er in_cs: Thanks all — keep updates in the ticket and ping here for urgent changes. :white_check_mark:
